target: TouchDesigner 2023.12230; native GLSL MAT/TOP, parameter glslversion=glsl430 (native probe verified)
geometry: Rectangle SOP on XY, P.x/y -0.5..0.5; identity Geometry COMP; native instancing enabled with exact count and no per-instance transform channels
textures: RGBA32F, nearest, no mipmaps; linear texel id=(row*width+column); all samplers of one draw share dimensions; unused texels zero

camera.uCameraForward: unit world forward into scene xyz

shared.uPointScale: retained compatibility uniform; perspective uses camera+viewport

rendering.color: RGBA16F or RGBA32F Render TOP, transparent black clear, MAT RGB blend Source Alpha + One, postmultalpha=False, depth-test on, depth-write off
rendering.depth: second native RGBA32F Render TOP of dust/filaments/stars only; clone MAT uDepthPass=1, blend off, depth-test/write on, opaque white clear; output R is normalized window depth
rendering.core: core.frag GLSL TOP, RGBA32F, numcolorbufs=2; buffer0 linear premultiplied emission RGBA, buffer1 normalized depth R (far1 on no hit); wire core to Render Select TOP and set index=1 (2023 native parameter)
rendering.composite: inputs [fieldColor,fieldDepth,coreColor,coreDepth] in this order; native perspective camera must match the vector uniforms; leave inputfiltertype linear for color, depth uses shader-enforced nearest texelFetch with clamp-to-edge matching browser depth textures
rendering.bloom: bloom-extract input composite, half resolution; bloom-blur horizontal then vertical for spread1.0 and2.4: uBlurStep=(spread/W,0,0,0) or(0,spread/H,0,0)
rendering.finish: inputs [composite,finalBlur]; exact browser exposure1.18, bloom0.21, linear-to-sRGB and grain0.003; no additional output color transform
